title: The distilled-monoculture hypothesis: do high-distillation models share more failures?

original_idea.body:
# The distilled-monoculture hypothesis

Using published distillation-degree estimates (arXiv 2501.12619), group ~10 models into high-distillation vs distinct-lineage clusters and measure within- vs across-cluster error correlation on a fixed benchmark. Inference + correlation analysis on a consumer GPU.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain linking distillation lineage to correlated failure and concentration risk; catastrophic step not explicit.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: clear methodology (group by published estimates, measure error correlation); novice+mentor feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused first deliverable (within- vs across-cluster error correlation).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: public distillation estimates + open models, weak lab incentive, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference + correlation analysis on a consumer GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Specific distillation-predicts-correlated-failure test appears untested though built on existing components.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Combines two existing papers into an untested prediction; plausibly open angle.
